summary:
● Data Scientist with 4+ years in BFSI, adept at turning intricate datasets into actionable insights. Experienced in
predictive modeling, model validation, A/B testing, model optimization, forecasting and data visualization.
● Proficient in SQL, Python, R, Tableau and PySpark with strong foundation in statistics and ML from IIT Madras.
● Proven ability to lead teams, extract measurable business value from large-scale financial datasets, deliver
scalable data-driven solutions, and communicate findings effectively to both technical and business audiences.

skills._method: flashtext_skills_section | fuzzy(Scikit - Learn→scikit-learn(95%), Hadoop→Apache Hadoop(100%), KMeans→K-means Clustering(100%), KPI Tracking→KPI(100%), model optimization→Model Optimization(100%)...)

bullets: Built custom credit scorecards for New-to-Credit MSMEs using bureau data and proxy borrower behavior, developing segment-specific XGBoost models by loan size (KS up to ~34) to enable risk-based pricing and expand credit access, leading to a 13% reduction in defaults and higher approval rates for thin-file MSMEs.

Developed a robust GLM-based, industry-wide credit risk scorecard for personal loans using bureau features, delivering a 13-point GINI lift over CIBIL with KS ~33; cross-validated and adopted by multiple banks/NBFCs, reducing defaults, enhancing risk-return trade-offs, improving approval efficiency, and underwriting decisions.

Built an application scorecard for unsecured business loans with WOE binning & logistic regression, reducing 1,329 features to 11 key predictors and achieving 71% bad capture in the top 30% risk band (AUC 0.75, KS 35).

Led development of 1,800+ K-Means–based peer group algorithms at a leading credit bureau, boosting legacy credit scoring performance by 20–23% (statistically significant, p < 0.05); owned full model lifecycle from data processing and feature engineering through model validation, governance reviews, and stakeholder delivery.

Built a Propensity-to-Pay scorecard for DPD 90+ portfolios, capturing ~70% of recoverable NPA accounts (≥5% repayment within 3 months) in the top 30% scored segment (KS ~33), enabling focused recovery prioritization.

Performed EDA using SQL and Excel on 100Cr+ credit records to identify risk anomalies and fraud patterns; validated 700+ key-risk indicators aligned with RBI compliance, such as identity theft and behavioral risk flags.

Designed and deployed a high-accuracy demand forecasting model for U.S. natural gas (Python, Scikit-learn) with R² > 90%, quantifying weather and commodity sensitivities to inform $50M+ portfolio risk decisions.

Streamlined data pipelines and BI workflows across 100+ SQL assets and 50+ Tableau dashboards, boosting trading decisions by 55% via long-term fundamentals and live market data integration, driving $10M+ revenue.

Delivered a 38% improvement in forecast accuracy by upgrading time-series models to XGBoost and applying targeted feature engineering to reduce dimensionality by 98%, enhancing driver-level explainability.
